scope: Every literal tmp-path citation in C2 evidence Markdown at generation, with brace/glob expansion and recursive hashes for available directory citations. The shared dev-runner path resolves in the main repo. Bare tmp/ denotes a storage root, not a raw artifact. Unresolved strings are retained honestly, never treated as proof.
retention: Local raw artifacts remain in this lane worktree through lane F acceptance plus 30 days and must be exported before worktree release. Hosted artifacts retain their run-specific expiry. Hashes establish identity, not availability; citations name accessible local paths or hosted run artifacts.
